name: Markor
desc:
**Markor** is a savannah region in [the Central Luminant](location:luminants), the homeland of Felinor, and currently a territory conquered by [the Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority).

Along with the Felinor originating from here, Markor is also the origin of scimitars and similar blades. The Sea Highways also come from here, made by a company of Thundercallers, known as the Golden Link.
